Content.SourceString: 听说娜娜莉小姐康复了，太好了OwO！！
Content.LocalizedString: I heard Nanally is recovering! That's great news! OwO

Content.SourceString: 不知道她喜不喜欢我的礼物呢？
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder if she likes my present!

Content.SourceString: 对了，现在我在异象管理局工作啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! By the way, I got a job at the BAC!

Content.SourceString: 有机会的话，想来伊波恩找大家玩~
Content.LocalizedString: If there's a chance, I want to visit everyone at Eibon!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，要来纳库佩达公园玩吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, wanna come to the Nacupeda Park?

Content.SourceString: 好啊，什么时候？
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, when should I get there?

Content.SourceString: 我现在就在纳库佩达公园。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm already in the Nacupeda Park.

Content.SourceString: 现在可以吗？我已经在啦
Content.LocalizedString: Can you come now? I'm already there

Content.SourceString: 哦~哦~我在你背后哦！
Content.LocalizedString: Ooooh, I'm behind you!

Content.SourceString: OwO
Content.LocalizedString: OwO

Content.SourceString: OwO
Content.LocalizedString: OwO

Content.SourceString: 雨好大。
Content.LocalizedString: It's pouring.

Content.SourceString: 现在有在下雨吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is it raining now?

Content.SourceString: 确实，雨很大呢。
Content.LocalizedString: You're right. It's raining heavily.

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，忘了我们不在同一个地方><
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I forgot we're not at the same place ><

Content.SourceString: 莫非鉴定师就在我附近？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you happen to be around here?

Content.SourceString: 可以来找你吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can I go find you right now?

Content.SourceString: 诶？可以倒是可以……
Content.LocalizedString: Umm, sure, why not…

Content.SourceString: 是有什么事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there anything wrong?

Content.SourceString: 等见面了再说吧。鉴定师发一下定位给我~
Content.LocalizedString: I'll tell you when we meet. Give me a location ping!

Content.SourceString: 我这里好像没有分享定位的功能……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think I have that function on my phone…

Content.SourceString: 还是我来找你吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll go find you instead.

Content.SourceString: 好><谢谢鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Got it > < Thanks, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 好><谢谢鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Got it > < Thanks, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 伊洛伊长出新芽了。
Content.LocalizedString: Iroi has a new bud.

Content.SourceString: 是说你的「宠物树」伊洛伊吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You mean your pet tree, Iroi?

Content.SourceString: 什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Huh?

Content.SourceString: 对呀。
Content.LocalizedString: Yep.

Content.SourceString: 是我们种的树。鉴定师还记得吗？
Content.LocalizedString: It's the tree we planted. Appraiser, you remember?

Content.SourceString: 我自己可没法发芽呢OwO
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not something that can sprout OwO

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，小树成长起来了呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Ah yes, the sapling has grown.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师要来看看吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you want to come take a look?

Content.SourceString: 还有另一件值得庆祝的事情哦~等你来了就能知道！
Content.LocalizedString: There's also something that's worth celebrating. You'll know it when you get here!

Content.SourceString: 好，我现在过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Gotcha, I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 好，我现在过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Gotcha, I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 海特洛好像没有「四季」的区别呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Hethereau doesn't seem to have seasons.

Content.SourceString: 确实没有。虽然偶尔会下雪……
Content.LocalizedString: You're right. It does snow sometimes though…

Content.SourceString: 有的吧，有时候会下雪。
Content.LocalizedString: It does. It even snows sometimes.

Content.SourceString: 但那也只是短暂地下一场雪，不是真正的冬天U^U
Content.LocalizedString: Those are just occasional snowy days. It's far from having a real winter U^U

Content.SourceString: 海特洛一年四季都是春天。
Content.LocalizedString: Hethereau is always in spring.

Content.SourceString: 可是，没有冬天的话，不就也没有春天了吗0 0
Content.LocalizedString: But how can you have spring if you don't have winter? o_O

Content.SourceString: 旧的叶子不落下来，就不会有新叶子长出来……差不多的感觉？
Content.LocalizedString: New leaves won't grow if old ones don't fall… something like that?

Content.SourceString: 说出了很有哲理的话……
Content.LocalizedString: That's really deep…

Content.SourceString: 诶诶诶？是我说错什么了吗><！
Content.LocalizedString: Huuuh? Did I say something weird? ><

Content.SourceString: 不是这个意思……
Content.LocalizedString: That's not what I meant…

Content.SourceString: 没有说什么让鉴定师感到不舒服的话就好……
Content.LocalizedString: I just didn't want to say anything that made you feel weird…

Content.SourceString: 话说回来，好想体会有四季变化的感觉啊><
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, I wanna know what the changing of the seasons feels like ><

Content.SourceString: 随着日子一天天过去，气温慢慢变冷或者变热，就会有一种「时间真的在向前走诶！」的感觉呢~
Content.LocalizedString: When it slowly gets colder or warmer as time goes by, you get this feeling that "time really is marching on"!

Content.SourceString: 好有道理……
Content.LocalizedString: That's so true…

Content.SourceString: 好奇妙的思路……
Content.LocalizedString: You have interesting thoughts…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，对不起。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然道歉？
Content.LocalizedString: All of a sudden?

Content.SourceString: 没关系……虽然话是这么说，但你这是怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: All good… but what's going on with you?

Content.SourceString: 只是突然想说对不起。
Content.LocalizedString: I just wanted to apologize.

Content.SourceString: 但你也没有什么地方对不起我啊？
Content.LocalizedString: It's not like you have something to apologize for.

Content.SourceString: 因为我知道自己有的时候会说一些不太对的话><
Content.LocalizedString: It's because sometimes I say weird stuff!

Content.SourceString: 所以想着，能不能把之前所~有可能让鉴定师感到不舒服的事情打包到一起
Content.LocalizedString: So I was thinking if it was possible to wrap up every instance of me making you uncomfortable…

Content.SourceString: 然后郑重来道一个歉！
Content.LocalizedString: …and apologize for them once and for all!

Content.SourceString: 没有那样的事，你不用道歉。
Content.LocalizedString: That's not true. You don't need to apologize.

Content.SourceString: 好的，我接受你的道歉。
Content.LocalizedString: Very well. Apology accepted.
Appraiser… ><!!!

Content.SourceString: 谢谢鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 为什么要说谢谢？
Content.LocalizedString: Buy why do you need to thank me?

Content.SourceString: 呜哇！这样说也很奇怪吗？对不起！
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh! Is that strange to say too? Sorry!

Content.SourceString: 又在道歉了……
Content.LocalizedString: You're apologizing again…

Content.SourceString: 或许鉴定师知道，娜娜莉小姐平常是怎么护理尾巴的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you know anything about Nanally's tail care routine?

Content.SourceString: 之前也问过薄荷，想着再多向别人汲取一下经验OwO
Content.LocalizedString: I also asked Mint, but I want to ask a few more people OwO

Content.SourceString: 印象里，薄荷和娜娜莉都比较爱用「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」。
Content.LocalizedString: iirc, Mint and Nanally like using the Fluffy Tail Care Spray.

Content.SourceString: 可以用这个试试？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe you can try it?

Content.SourceString: 这个我有用过，对我来说不太好用><
Content.LocalizedString: I already did, but I don't really like this one ><

Content.SourceString: 可能我们的尾巴构造不太一样吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I think the hairs on our tails are different.

Content.SourceString: 好想认识尾巴和我一样的异能者呀
Content.LocalizedString: I wish I knew Espers with tails like mine

Content.SourceString: 确实没怎么见过像小羊的异能者……
Content.LocalizedString: Somehow I haven't seen many bovid Espers…

Content.SourceString: 明明小羊也不算什么稀有物种0 0
Content.LocalizedString: Bovids aren't that rare o_O

Content.SourceString: 但就算在呗果上也没怎么刷到过
Content.LocalizedString: But I haven't seen any on Bagel

Content.SourceString: 这么说，伊洛伊就是独一无二的。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm pretty sure that you are one of a kind.

Content.SourceString: ……这样说也不太准确，就算有像小羊的异能者，伊洛伊也是独一无二的。
Content.LocalizedString: To be precise… even if there are other Espers that look like bovids, you are still one of a kind.

Content.SourceString: ……好像扯远了。
Content.LocalizedString: …I digress.

Content.SourceString: Likeability_biaoqing_007
Content.LocalizedString: Likeability_biaoqing_007
Appraiser… >///<!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师喜欢画画吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you like sketching?

Content.SourceString: 喜欢。
Content.LocalizedString: I do.

Content.SourceString: 不喜欢。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't.

Content.SourceString: 太好啦！我们一起去写生吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Great! Let's go sketching together!

Content.SourceString: 那要不要一起去采风呀OwO顺便给你画肖像什么的！
Content.LocalizedString: Then do you want to walk around? OwO I'll get a sketch done for you!

Content.SourceString: 在海特洛闲逛的时候，我找到了挺多漂亮的地方。
Content.LocalizedString: I found many pretty places when I was walking around Hethereau.

Content.SourceString: 想把这些景象全都画下来~
Content.LocalizedString: I want to record what I saw!

Content.SourceString: 不能直接拍照吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can't you just take photos?

Content.SourceString: 总觉得照片和眼睛看到的不太一样……
Content.LocalizedString: What I see and what photos capture are different…

Content.SourceString: 不过也有可能是我眼睛有问题啦><
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe there's something wrong with my sight ><

Content.SourceString: 但总之就是，想把自己「亲眼」看到的色彩和光影画下来！
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, I just want to draw the colors and lights I saw!

Content.SourceString: 想看看伊洛伊的画……
Content.LocalizedString: Want to see your work…

Content.SourceString: 好呀好呀，有机会我给你带过来！
Content.LocalizedString: Sure sure! I'll show you when I can!

Content.SourceString: 诶不过
Content.LocalizedString: Erm but
Umm…

Content.SourceString: 怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 上次给薄荷和真红看过，她们好像……被吓到了
Content.LocalizedString: I showed Shinku and Mint before, but they seemed… scared

Content.SourceString: 她们一直在说「不敢看」「好可怕」之类的话><但我看着也不知道是哪里出了问题……明明只是把眼前看到的画下来了
Content.LocalizedString: They kept saying they were too scared to look >< But I couldn't tell what went wrong… I just drew whatever I saw

Content.SourceString: 害怕鉴定师也会吓到！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm scared that I'll freak you out too!

Content.SourceString: 所以我觉得，还是不要看比较好吧……
Content.LocalizedString: So maybe it's better that I don't show you at all…

Content.SourceString: 这么说，肖像也最好不要画了……！><!!对不起！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, that means I probably shouldn't sketch a portrait of you too…! ><!! Sorry!

Content.SourceString: 究竟是什么样的画……
Content.LocalizedString: What do your drawings look like…

Content.SourceString: 明天要做什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What are you doing tmr?

Content.SourceString: 起床，吃饭，接委托……跟往常一样。
Content.LocalizedString: Wake up, eat, take commissions… Same old, same old.

Content.SourceString: 如果有什么突发事件的话，解决掉。然后吃饭，接委托，睡觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Solve any unexpected issues, then eat, take commissions, and sleep.

Content.SourceString: 原来大家都是这样的啊。
Content.LocalizedString: So everyone's like that.

Content.SourceString: 还以为是我的生活出了什么问题……大家都这样我就放心了0 0
Content.LocalizedString: I thought there was something wrong with my routine… I'm glad that it's the same for everyone o_O

Content.SourceString: 难道你一直在担心些什么吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Were you worried about anything?

Content.SourceString: 嗯。如果每天都过得一样的话，还有什么一天天过下去的必要呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Mm. What's the point of living when every day is just rise and repeat?

Content.SourceString: 怎么想都很奇怪啊><
Content.LocalizedString: Isn't that strange? ><

Content.SourceString: 但也经常会有一些「突发事件」，对吧？
Content.LocalizedString: But occasionally, unexpected things show up, don't they?

Content.SourceString: 「明天会不会有新鲜事发生呢」，如果有这样的期待的话，就会变得有趣了。
Content.LocalizedString: "Is something fun going to happen tomorrow?" If you look forward to those things, it'd be a lot more fun.

Content.SourceString: 当然，也有人的生活不是这样平静的。对不幸的人来说，「明天会不会变好」也是一种期待。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, not everyone is like that. For unfortunate people, they just want things to be better the next day.

Content.SourceString: 只要生活还在继续下去，大家就会有很多个明天可以期待。
Content.LocalizedString: As long as we keep living, we will have many tomorrows to look forward to.

Content.SourceString: 就这样，哪怕是一模一样的日子，也能一天天过下去啦。
Content.LocalizedString: In this way, even if each day is rinse and repeat, there is still something worth looking forward to.

Content.SourceString: 是这样啊……
Content.LocalizedString: I see…

Content.SourceString: 还会有很多个明天呢。
Content.LocalizedString: There will be many tomorrows.

Content.SourceString: 嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah.

Content.SourceString: 明天见。
Content.LocalizedString: See you tomorrow.

Content.SourceString: 你好呀~我是奥涅伊洛伊，很高兴认识你！
Content.LocalizedString: Hi there! I'm Oneiroi. Happy to meet you!

Content.SourceString: 「奥涅伊洛伊」是你的全名吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is "Oneiroi" your full name?

Content.SourceString: 是的哦~不过叫起来实在是太拗口啦，所以大家一般都喊我伊洛伊~
Content.LocalizedString: Ya! But it's too hard to pronounce, so everyone just calls me Iroi!

Content.SourceString: 当然啦，如果你愿意的话，也可以叫我的全名~我都可以的哦OwO
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, you can call me my full name if you prefer. I'm fine with either OwO

Content.SourceString: 奥涅伊洛伊……还是伊洛伊吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Oneiroi… I'll go with Iroi.

Content.SourceString: 冒昧问一句，这是你自己起的名字吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is it okay if I ask how you got that name?

Content.SourceString: 不冒昧不冒昧~
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, of course!

Content.SourceString: 这是爸爸妈妈给我取的名字哦~
Content.LocalizedString: My mom and dad gave me that name!

Content.SourceString: 听说这个名字背后有什么寓意之类的……
Content.LocalizedString: They told me there's some meaning to the name…

Content.SourceString: 但我觉得，他们只是随便敲了几个字上去啦~
Content.LocalizedString: But I think they just mashed some letters together!

Content.SourceString: 说不定真的是这样。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe that was the case.

Content.SourceString: 应该还是有特别寓意的吧。
Content.LocalizedString: There should be some special meaning to your name.

Content.SourceString: 对吧对吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Right?

Content.SourceString: 也许吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe!

Content.SourceString: 不过，这个名字虽然拗口，念起来还是很好听的~我还是很喜欢的！
Content.LocalizedString: Though my name is hard to pronounce, I do like how it sounds!

Content.SourceString: 希望你也能喜欢！
Content.LocalizedString: I hope you like it too!

Content.SourceString: 嗯……好的。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course… I will.

Content.SourceString: 好哦好哦~
Content.LocalizedString: Yay yay!

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，有新工作来了，我们下次再聊><！！再见~
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I just got a task. Let's chat some other time ><! See ya!

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉小姐的状况……怎么样了？
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally's condition… is it getting better?

Content.SourceString: 还是那样……
Content.LocalizedString: She's still the same…

Content.SourceString: 但不管怎样，谢谢你的老虎玩偶。她一定会很喜欢的。
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, thank you for the tiger plushie. I'm sure she'll like it.

Content.SourceString: 哇！太好啦~
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks for letting me know!

Content.SourceString: 其实我也是第一次缝这种娃娃，有点粗糙，下次我再做个更好点的寄来~！
Content.LocalizedString: It was my first time sewing a plushie like that. It's not my best work. I'll send a better one the next time!

Content.SourceString: 对了，也给鉴定师做一个吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I should make one for you too!

Content.SourceString: 那就先谢谢你啦。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks in advance then.

Content.SourceString: 我就不用了……
Content.LocalizedString: I'll pass…

Content.SourceString: 喔，好OwO
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, okay OwO

Content.SourceString: 不过，说不定不用寄来，可以由我自己带过来呢~
Content.LocalizedString: But maybe instead of sending it over, I can bring it over myself!

Content.SourceString: 最近福利院的氛围变得好奇怪。感觉，自己应该在这儿待不了多久了。
Content.LocalizedString: The charity house feels so weird now. I don't think I'm staying here any longer.

Content.SourceString: 离开了福利院，就可以回海特洛城里了，就可以来找你们玩了~
Content.LocalizedString: Once I leave the charity house, I'll be able to play with you in Hethereau!

Content.SourceString: 那样听起来也不错。
Content.LocalizedString: That sounds good to me.

Content.SourceString: 嗯！
Content.LocalizedString: Yep!

Content.SourceString: 愉快的游戏时间结束了~
Content.LocalizedString: Play time is over!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师会有这种感觉吗？在一个故事结束后，心里空荡荡的那种感觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you feel this? That empty void in your heart when the story ends.

Content.SourceString: 会有一点。
Content.LocalizedString: I get a bit of that.

Content.SourceString: 完全没有。
Content.LocalizedString: Not at all.

Content.SourceString: 我也有呢。好像脑子还在故事的世界里打转，身体已经在迎接现实……
Content.LocalizedString: Same here. It's like the story is still spiraling in my mind, but my body is ready to return to reality…

Content.SourceString: 我也是这样的耶。之前听到有人说「好希望这个故事永远不结束」，就觉得有些奇怪~
Content.LocalizedString: I'm like that too. I once heard someone say they wished a story never ended. That was strange.

Content.SourceString: 一个故事结束了，才能迎接下一个嘛OwO
Content.LocalizedString: One story ends for another to begin, right? OwO

Content.SourceString: 不知道以后还有没有一起玩游戏的机会呢？好期待新的故事呀。
Content.LocalizedString: I wonder if we can play some games together. I'm looking forward to a new story!

Content.SourceString: 伊洛伊似乎很喜欢听故事？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you a story lover?

Content.SourceString: 不用亲身经历，就能体会到不同时空下各种各样的事情，很美妙，也很安全！
Content.LocalizedString: Without living through it firsthand, I get to experience all kinds of things across times and places. It's wonderful and safe!

Content.SourceString: （虽然我们玩的游戏还是挺「亲身经历」的来着！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Although the game we played was pretty "firsthand.")

Content.SourceString: 很安全是指……？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you mean by "safe"…?

Content.SourceString: 不用真正面对故事里的困难，却能体会克服困难的喜悦……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't have to face the hardships in the story, but I still get to feel the joy of overcoming them…

Content.SourceString: 就像是凭空多出一段生命一样OwO
Content.LocalizedString: It's like I somehow received an extra life OwO

Content.SourceString: 确实……
Content.LocalizedString: Makes sense…
